title: Got feedback from a youtuber
author: Environmental-Wear13
selftext:
Would love getting your feedback on a rehauled system I've been working on a few days.

Background story. Last week, I released the demo for my game Shadows of Imalor on steam after quite extensive playtesting. Even though I felt ready for the demo release, there were still quite a bit of things I've missed. Lucky enough, I got covered by a smaller youtuber called "Games with Galt" which played my demo for 48 minutes. This of course became a goldmine for me. Just a few hours later I released my first patch to address some of the concerns which I thought were super valid.

And for a few days I've been thinking how I wanted to rehaul one part of my combat which was kind of confusing and honestly, quite boring... blocking. 

Before, there was no real visual confirmation that you were blocking and if you went out of stamina, the damage just went through. Not super clear. You could also block in any direction no matter where you were aiming.

Now you have a cone of where you are blocking. Being shot and blocking in the wrong direction, you receive full damage. There's also a "perfect blocking" window, if you start blocking close to being hit, you'll loose less stamina. And getting out of stamina while blocking, there's clear visuals that your block broke. Astra has been pretty amazing at helping me very fast with these fixes but it took some time getting the feeling just right.

Would love your feedback. Anything you think about that could make this even more fun or clear or simply more visual pleasing?

Games with Galt - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6h9Xa2iwl3M&t=1520s](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6h9Xa2iwl3M&t=1520s)
